_comment: Input to L1-github-orchestrator, DESIGN-PUBLISH INVOCATION (BOM Phase 4). Takes the outputs of every Phase 4 design agent and commits the whole Feature Design Package to the design branch, then publishes to Confluence. It commits the package; it does not merge it. Merge happens at Phase 7.5, after the PR lands, so the canonical documents only move once the change is real.

fdp_manifest.structure_rule: 00-overview.md is the only original content in the package. deltas/ holds files that each have a named canonical destination. additive/ holds journeys and wireframes, which are additive by nature and never merged. Nothing is authored twice, so nothing can drift.

overview.authored_by: L1-design-hld (assumed — no Phase 4 agent row names the author of 00-overview.md; flagged as a BOM gap by the integration architect)

viewpoint_assertion_table.detail: 3 creating HLD deltas + 3 creating LLD deltas; catalogue-service, orders-service, billing-service, buyer-web asserted NONE with reasons
extending 1.0 -> 1.1; register_reason classified; DAT-PEND-04 added; db-schema.sql emitted separately
1.0 -> 2.0; new external edge; ADR-012 required; EA approval pending
extending 1.0 -> 1.1; PLT-6 outbound third-party egress NOT PRESENT -> AVAILABLE; new egress-gateway component

github.merge_policy: This invocation COMMITS only. Merge of deltas into their canonical destinations happens at Phase 7.5, after the PR lands.
